say:1:1035713001:1.text: What do you know?! This is every treasure hunter's dream!
say:1:1035713001:1.source_cn: 你懂什么！这是每个盗宝贼的梦想！
say:1:1035713001:1.male: What do you know?! This is every treasure hunter's dream!
say:1:1035713001:1.female: What do you know?! This is every treasure hunter's dream!

say:2:1035713002:1.text: Discovering legendary treasure, sleeping on a priceless bed of gems, and even diving into a pool of gold coins!
say:2:1035713002:1.source_cn: 找到传说中的宝藏，睡在价值连城的黄金床上，连洗澡都是用...
say:2:1035713002:1.male: Discovering legendary treasure, sleeping on a priceless bed of gems, and even diving into a pool of gold coins!
say:2:1035713002:1.female: Discovering legendary treasure, sleeping on a priceless bed of gems, and even diving into a pool of gold coins!

say:3:1035713003:1.text: But the best part is waking up the next day and finding out it's all real!
say:3:1035713003:1.source_cn: 更重要的是，当你醒来时，会发现这一切居然是真的！天哪！
say:3:1035713003:1.male: But the best part is waking up the next day and finding out it's all real!
say:3:1035713003:1.female: But the best part is waking up the next day and finding out it's all real!
